dispensing.title: Opioid Dispensing Rate Maps
dispensing.content_source: National Center for Injury Prevention and Control
dispensing.definition: Projected annual opioid prescription totals / annual resident population × 100
dispensing.coverage: Approximately 54,600 retail non-hospital pharmacies, nearly 94% of retail prescriptions; county maps represent approximately 98% of counties per year.
exclusions: Methadone dispensed through methadone treatment programs
dispensing.provenance_limit: Page update date does not establish uploaded export release.

overdose.title: VSRR Provisional County-Level Drug Overdose Death Counts
overdose.window_definition: Deaths in 12 months ending in indicated month; June 2020 covers July 1, 2019–June 30, 2020.
overdose.suggested_citation_text: Ahmad FB, Anderson RN, Cisewski JA, Rossen LM, Sutton P. County-level provisional drug overdose death counts. National Center for Health Statistics. [year]. DOI: https://dx.doi.org/10.15620/cdc/20250305009
overdose.provenance_limit: Live metadata extends beyond the uploaded 2020–2025 file; it is not a release identifier for that file.
